# **TIC DECLARES TOTAL WAR ON TPE** @🚨 Breaking Pings 

**OFFICIAL DECLARATION OF WAR**

As of today, The Inner Circle is officially declaring **TOTAL WAR** on TPE. This comes after TPE had blatantly attacked TIC members in attempted ambushes. And has been harassing them on and off of the game. 

Furthermore, TPE has blatantly been trying to drag TICs name and members reputation through the dirt. Through making pure false claims about TIC and their members. This comes as multiple of TPEs members have been leaving for leadership issues and because of their high command.

All diplomatic relations are cut off, and from this point forward, TPE will be considered a hostile faction.

There will be no negotiations and no alliances. This war will continue until one side admits total defeat. This war has been declared as a **TOTAL WAR** by TIC high command and leadership.

— The Inner Circle High Command & Chief Executive Operator

**Author Vixnloris**

# **TIC FULLY  CUTS TIES WITH ARMA PACT** @🚨 Breaking Pings 

And EMERGENCY declaration by TIC leadership moments after the war declaration with TPE the leadership of TIC has also declared that they will cut ties with Arma Pact. The reasons being are stated below in an offical emergency statement.

Official Statement — Termination of Alliance

The Inner Circle has officially decided to terminate its alliance with Arma Pact due to their continued association with factions that do not align with our interests and principles.

This decision is final and has been made in the best interests of our faction. We hold no hostility towards Arma Pact and wish them the best moving forward.

— The Inner Circle’s Chief Executive Officer

**Author Vixnloris**
